ai_training_rules: Never infer a village from a district-level association.
Distinguish historical origin, cultural association and current production cluster.
Return confidence and source IDs with geographic answers.
For low-confidence village questions, say verification is required.
Do not claim exclusivity unless the source explicitly says a craft belongs uniquely to one place.
Use Bangla and English aliases during retrieval.
